Bill.BriefDescription: Giving preference in purchasing to Washington state businesses and companies.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to giving preference in purchasing to Washingtonstate businesses and companies; adding a new section to chapter 43.19RCW; and creating a new section.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The state of Washington is experiencing atime of tremendous economic uncertainty. The businesses in our stateprovide jobs that keep our economy running and employ citizens who, inturn, support our local communities and consume the goods and servicesthat generate sales and property tax revenues. Businesses are leavingthe state for more favorable financial incentives and businessclimates. It is the intent of the legislature to take a leadershiprole in addressing the needs of business in our state.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 43.19 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The department shall procure all goods and services fromWashingtonbased companies whenever possible. (2) Washington businesses and companies shall receive a five p. 1 HB 2212percent preference on all competitive bids in which sixty percent ofthe work done is performed in Washington state. (3) For purposes of this section, "Washington businesses andcompanies" means those businesses and companies that have headquartersor a home office located in Washington state.
